title: Jad plugin manifest (plugin.json)
description: The manifest at the top of a plugin folder, which `jad plugin install <folder>` installs. Beside it the folder holds any of models/, mcp/, tools/ (toolsets, with their hooks) and profiles/ (agents), each with <file>.json catalog files; skills/<skill>/SKILL.md skill folders; commands/, Markdown custom slash commands copied to <first of libraries.command_dirs>/<name>, so they are /<name>:<command>; and files/, copied to <state>/.plugins/<name>/files, whose path replaces ${JAD_PLUGIN_FILES} in the catalog files. README, LICENSE and CHANGELOG files and hidden entries are ignored; anything else is refused.

name.description: The plugin's name and the category its catalog files are installed under: mcp/<name>/<file>.json and so on. The plugin's files name each other as <name>/<file>.

version.description: Shown by jad plugin list; no rule applies to it.
